name: Send message
description: Send a text message, an image, or both into a Snapchat Web chat; ok only when the chat row shows Delivered. Pass name to open the chat first, or run with a chat already focused. Stops on the My AI disclaimer. Writes — use a test account.

name.description: Optional exact chat display name (friend or group) to open first; partial names are refused with suggestions. Avoid My AI.

text.description: Message text. Sent alone, or as the caption with image.png. Provide text and/or image.png.

image.png.description: Optional image to send (png/jpeg/gif). Provide text and/or image.png.
